summary: Unquoted alphabetic values produce misleading diagnostics: value=trust reports column 8 and Expected `rue`. The fix dispatches alphabetic values to complete boolean and special-float literals, reporting column 7 and Expected `true`, `false`, `inf` or `nan`. Removing that dispatch restores the faulty behavior. Blocked on test selection: the detecting upstream fixture, tests/fixtures/invalid/string-no-quotes-constant-like.stderr, was updated by this fix, but tests/test_invalid.rs registers it dynamically through fs_snapshot with harness=false. It has no Rust test function name accepted by the current runner's function-based discovery. No corresponding named regression test was found; no tests were executed.
